title: Kepler4D: Controllable Future Video Generation via 4D Scene State Evolution
title_zh: Kepler4D：通过4D场景状态演化实现可控的未来视频生成

paragraphs.en: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict how dynamic objects evolve beyond visual observations. We present Kepler4D, a framework for future video generation through explicit 4D scene state evolution. Given a monocular video, Kepler4D constructs a shared 3D representation of background geometry, object motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context. Chain-of-Motion summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to select structured speed and heading decisions and decide whether to bound object-center height from below. A deterministic rollout converts these decisions into future object trajectories for inspection and editing before synthesis. We render the evolving proxies into geometric controls for a pretrained video generator, separating coarse object motion from the synthesis of appearance and articulation. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate that Kepler4D enables controllable object motion and plausible future rollout while preserving scene consistency. The project page and code are available at https://brack-wang.github.io/kepler4d/ .
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型旨在保留场景结构，并预测动态物体在视觉观察之外的演化方式。 我们提出了 Kepler4D，一个通过显式 4D 场景状态演进来生成未来视频的框架。 给定单目视频，Kepler4D 会构建背景几何、物体运动历史、粗略空间支撑和语义语境的共享 3D 表示。 Chain-of-Motion 会总结观察到的运动，并利用视觉-语言模型选择结构化的速度和方向决策，同时决定是否对物体中心高度设置下限。 确定性展开会将这些决策转化为未来的物体轨迹，以便在合成前进行检查和编辑。 我们将演化的代理对象渲染为预训练视频生成器的几何控制项，从而将粗略的物体运动与外观和关节运动的合成分离开来。 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，Kepler4D 能够在保持场景一致性的同时，实现可控的物体运动和可信的未来展开。 项目页面和代码可在 https://brack-wang.github.io/kepler4d/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict plausible future dynamics from visual observations ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Future video generation is valuable for anticipating scene changes and exploring possible outcomes beyond the observed frames, supporting scenario generation for autonomous driving ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , visual planning for robotic manipulation ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Dharmarajan et al., 2026 ) , and action-controllable simulation of interactive environments ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型旨在保留场景结构，并根据视觉观察结果预测合理的未来动态（Wang 等，2025；Duan 等，2026；Chen 等，2025；Wu 等，2025）。 未来的视频生成对于预测场景变化、探索超出已观察帧的可能结果具有重要价值，可为自动驾驶的场景生成（Hu 等，2023；Wang 等，2024a）、机器人操作的视觉规划（Zhou 等，2024；Dharmarajan 等，2026）以及交互式环境的动作可控模拟（Yang 等，2023；Bruce 等，2024）提供支持。

paragraphs.en: Recent video world models have made progress in maintaining scene structure. Reconstructed spatial memory, geometric caches, and rendered controls improve consistency across camera viewpoints ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Other methods address dynamic subjects and events that evolve outside the current view ( Duan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Geometry-based controllers also enable camera redirection ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and joint control of camera and object trajectories ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . However, these scene-consistency and geometric-control approaches typically leave future motion to video synthesis or require external trajectories. Joint motion prediction and editing therefore benefit from a shared scene representation that connects observed motion and scene context to explicit future object trajectories and their rendering as video generation controls.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频世界模型在维持场景结构方面取得了进展。 重建的空间记忆、几何缓存和渲染控制能够提升不同摄像头视角之间的一致性（Wu 等，2025；Ren 等，2025；Wang 等，2025）。 其他方法则处理当前视野之外动态变化的主体和事件（Duan 等，2026；Chen 等，2026）。 基于几何的控制器还支持摄像头重定向（Yu 等，2025）以及摄像头与物体轨迹的联合控制（Zheng 等，2026）。 然而，这些场景一致性和几何控制方法通常将未来运动交由视频合成处理，或需要外部提供的轨迹。 因此，联合运动预测与编辑能够从共享的场景表示中受益，这种表示将观测到的运动和场景上下文与明确的未来物体轨迹及其作为视频生成控制的渲染结果连接起来。

paragraphs.en: We propose Kepler4D , a controllable video world model that observes motion history, predicts scene-aware 3D trajectories, and renders them as motion guidance for future generation. At its core is a structured 4D scene state that organizes static scene geometry, foreground motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context in a shared world frame. Static geometry anchors scene structure, while foreground motion states provide the basis for predicting future object trajectories. By evolving object centers within this shared 4D state, Kepler4D makes future motion explicit and available for inspection and editing before video synthesis. This formulation supports automatic future evolution, language-guided trajectory editing, and rendering under different camera viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Kepler4D，这是一种可控的视频世界模型，能够观察运动历史、预测场景感知的三维轨迹，并将其渲染为未来生成的运动指导。 其核心是一个结构化的四维场景状态，该状态将静态场景几何、前景运动历史、粗略的空间支撑和语义上下文组织在共享的世界坐标系中。 静态几何结构锚定了场景的结构，而前景运动状态则为预测未来物体轨迹提供了基础。 通过在共享的四维状态中演化物体中心，Kepler4D 使未来运动变得明确，并可在视频合成前进行检查和编辑。 这种构建方式支持自动的未来演化、语言引导的轨迹编辑，以及在不同摄像机视角下的渲染。

paragraphs.en: Kepler4D combines state construction, motion reasoning, and controllable rendering. First, it lifts the input video into background geometry and an object proxy bank, where each proxy stores semantic identity, an observed 3D trajectory, and coarse spatial support. Second, Chain-of-Motion (CoM) summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to infer structured motion decisions from these summaries and scene context. Deterministic rollout converts decisions into future 3D trajectories for inspection or editing before synthesis. Third, predicted or edited trajectories are rendered with background geometry as geometric control maps under a target camera sequence. These controls guide a pretrained video generator, with background geometry anchoring layout and moving proxies guiding foreground displacement. The generator synthesizes appearance and local articulation; trajectories expose coarse object motion throughout prediction, editing, and synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: Kepler4D 结合了状态构建、运动推理和可控渲染。 首先，它将输入视频提升为背景几何体和对象代理库，其中每个代理都存储语义身份、观测到的三维轨迹和粗略的空间支撑。 其次，运动链（CoM）总结观测到的运动，并利用视觉语言模型从这些摘要和场景上下文中推断出结构化的运动决策。 确定性展开将决策转换为未来的三维轨迹，以便在合成前进行检查或编辑。 第三，预测或编辑后的轨迹会与背景几何体一起，作为目标相机序列下的几何控制图进行渲染。 这些控制会引导一个预训练的视频生成器，其中背景几何体用于固定布局，而移动的代理则引导前景的位移。 该生成器会合成外观和局部关节运动；轨迹在整个预测、编辑和合成过程中揭示了物体的粗略运动。

paragraphs.en: Video World Models and Geometric Control. Video world models ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Duan et al., 2026 ) aim to simulate scene evolution from visual observations and control signals. Spatial-memory methods use reconstructed geometry to preserve scene structure across generated views ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) and hybrid-memory approaches ( Chen et al., 2026 ) model dynamic events outside the current view. For viewpoint control, camera-conditioned generators encode target poses ( He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) , while TrajectoryCrafter ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and FreeOrbit4D ( Cao et al., 2026 ) use reconstructed geometry to redirect camera trajectories in monocular videos. Geometry Forcing improves 3D consistency by aligning intermediate diffusion features with pretrained geometric features during training ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . VerseCrafter supports joint camera and object control by rendering background geometry and per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories into conditioning maps ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Kepler4D renders editable 3D trajectories predicted from observed motion and scene context as geometric controls for future video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型与几何控制。 视频世界模型（Hu et al., 2023；Bruce et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025；Duan et al., 2026）旨在通过视觉观测和控制信号模拟场景的演化过程。 空间记忆方法利用重建的几何结构，在生成的不同视角中保持场景结构的连贯性（Wu et al., 2025；Ren et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025）。 LiveWorld（Duan et al., 2026）和混合记忆方法（Chen et al., 2026）能够模拟当前视角之外的动态事件。 在视角控制方面，相机条件生成器会编码目标姿态（He et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2024b），而 TrajectoryCrafter（Yu et al., 2025）和 FreeOrbit4D（Cao et al., 2026）则利用重建的几何结构，在单目视频中重新引导相机轨迹。 几何强制通过在训练过程中将中间扩散特征与预训练的几何特征对齐，从而提升三维一致性（Wu et al., 2026a）。 VerseCrafter 通过将背景几何和每个物体的三维高斯轨迹渲染到条件图中，实现相机与物体的联合控制（Zheng et al., 2026）。 Kepler4D 将基于观测到的运动和场景上下文预测的可编辑三维轨迹，渲染为未来视频生成的几何控制。

paragraphs.en: Motion Reasoning and Future Prediction. Motion prediction methods ( Seff et al., 2023 ; Moon et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) forecast trajectories from scene observations, motion histories, or language instructions. MotionLM formulates multi-agent forecasting as autoregressive prediction of discrete motion tokens ( Seff et al., 2023 ) , while VisionTrap incorporates visual features and textual supervision into trajectory prediction ( Moon et al., 2024 ) . VLIPP ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and TrajVLM-Gen ( Yang et al., 2025a ) use VLMs to predict coarse motion that guides video synthesis. SeeU learns continuous 4D dynamics from reconstructed observations to generate videos at unobserved times and viewpoints ( Yuan et al., 2026a ) . MolmoMotion predicts 3D point trajectories from visual history and language goals for downstream control and generation ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while OptiWorld optimizes trajectories for task goals under physical constraints ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) . Kepler4D combines structured VLM decisions with deterministic 3D rollout to predict scene-aware, editable future object-center trajectories, enabling automatic future evolution and controllable video generation. These trajectories provide direct object motion controls before future video synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 运动推理与未来预测。 运动预测方法（Seff et al., 2023；Moon et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025b；Yang et al., 2025a；Zhang et al., 2026）根据场景观察、运动历史或语言指令预测轨迹。 MotionLM将多智能体预测问题表述为对离散运动标记的自回归预测（Seff et al., 2023），而VisionTrap则将视觉特征和文本监督融入轨迹预测（Moon et al., 2024）。 VLIPP（Yang et al., 2025b）和TrajVLM-Gen（Yang et al., 2025a）利用VLM预测粗略的运动，以指导视频合成。 SeeU从重建的观察数据中学习连续的四维动态，从而在未观察到的时间和视角下生成视频（Yuan et al., 2026a）。 MolmoMotion根据视觉历史和语言目标预测三维点轨迹，用于下游控制与生成（Zhang et al., 2026），而OptiWorld则在物理约束下针对任务目标优化轨迹（Yuan et al., 2026b）。 Kepler4D将结构化的VLM决策与确定性的三维展开相结合，预测具备场景感知能力且可编辑的未来物体中心轨迹，从而实现自动的未来演化与可控的视频生成。 这些轨迹在合成未来视频之前，可直接提供对物体运动的控制。

paragraphs.en: For each future state, we render complementary background and foreground controls under the corresponding target camera pose. The background controls encode the appearance and depth of the static scene. Foreground objects are represented by coarse 3D Gaussian ellipsoids whose centers follow the predicted or edited trajectories and whose sizes are determined by the proxy supports. Rendering these proxies produces foreground color, depth, and motion masks that indicate where objects should appear in each future frame. Both sets of controls are derived from the shared world frame, allowing camera motion and object motion to jointly guide synthesis across all future frames. Here, changing the target camera pose changes the projection of the reconstructed state, whereas editing an object trajectory changes its center positions within that state. The same explicit motion plan can therefore be rendered under alternative target camera paths, and each object-motion edit remains defined in the shared scene rather than in the image coordinates of a particular camera view.

paragraphs.en: We first introduce the datasets and evaluation metrics. We then evaluate Kepler4D across three settings: static view synthesis in § 4.1 , automatic future video generation in § 4.2 , and controllable future video generation in § 4.3 . paragraphs.en: Datasets. We evaluate static view synthesis on the 55-scene DL3DV-Evaluation release ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , using the first 49 frames as observations and the provided camera trajectories for future viewpoints. Dynamic continuation and motion editing draw on the 90 sequences of the DAVIS 2017 train and validation splits ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ; Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) . For automatic continuation, we split 38 selected sequences from this pool into observed prefixes and held-out continuations. We estimate camera trajectories from the full sequences with Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and use future poses as external rendering conditions. Within each setting, all methods share observed frames; camera-controllable methods share the target camera path. Appendix B describes the dataset usage and temporal alignment procedures for these evaluations and the role of the target camera paths.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate reference similarity, visual quality, and motion accuracy. PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measure similarity to held-out frames. FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) compares feature distributions of generated and reference frames. VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) assesses visual quality, temporal consistency, and motion activity. Dynamic Degree measures activity, not accuracy. For dynamic continuation, Flow-EPE measures the full-image optical-flow difference between generated and reference videos, reflecting camera and object motion, while RotErr measures camera rotation error. For motion editing, we report the camera-yaw-based TurnErr proxy and VBench Imaging Quality. TurnErr reflects camera turning, not object heading independent of camera motion. PSNR measures similarity to the recorded continuation, which may not reflect the requested motion. Appendix C provides the metric definitions and evaluation protocols used here and explains the interpretation of each of the reported scores.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们评估参考相似性、视觉质量和运动准确性。 PSNR、SSIM（Wang 等，2004）和 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）用于衡量与预留帧的相似性。 FID（Heusel 等，2017）比较生成帧和参考帧的特征分布。 VBench（Huang 等，2024）评估视觉质量、时间一致性和运动活动。 动态程度衡量的是活动性，而非准确性。 对于动态延续，Flow-EPE 衡量生成视频与参考视频之间的全图像光流差异，反映相机和物体的运动；而 RotErr 则衡量相机旋转误差。 对于运动编辑，我们报告基于相机偏角的 TurnErr 代理指标以及 VBench 图像质量。 TurnErr 反映的是相机的转向，而非独立于相机运动的物体方向。 PSNR 衡量与记录延续部分的相似性，但这可能无法反映所请求的运动。 附录 C 提供了本文使用的指标定义和评估协议，并解释了所报告各项分数的含义。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate dynamic world evolution, where the task is to continue foreground motion from a monocular video while rendering the scene along a target future camera path. Experiments are conducted on DAVIS, where all methods receive the same observed video and target camera trajectory, but no object trajectories, mask sequences, or language motion commands. This setting tests whether object evolution can be inferred from visual observations without externally specified motion control.

paragraphs.en: Results. Table 2 evaluates Kepler4D in a challenging setting where foreground motion is inferred from the observed video without object trajectories or language motion commands. Kepler4D obtains favorable motion-fidelity scores while maintaining competitive reconstruction and generation quality. The lower Flow-EPE indicates closer overall image motion to the reference video, while the lower RotErr indicates more accurate following of the target camera rotation. The reconstruction and perceptual scores show that the complete pipeline maintains competitive visual quality during automatic continuation. SPMem maintains competitive pixel-level fidelity but has higher image-motion and camera-rotation errors in this evaluation. VerseCrafter achieves the lowest LPIPS, while its Flow-EPE and RotErr are higher than those of Kepler4D. Together, these results support explicit trajectory guidance within the complete pipeline for automatic future generation from video inputs.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 provides a qualitative comparison of these differences. The observed video already shows a parkour runner vaulting over a low wall. The future scene contains a railing along the runner’s route, and another vault is a plausible continuation given the observed activity and layout. The reference video and Kepler4D both show the person moving forward and vaulting over the railing. TrajectoryCrafter shows a viewpoint change without a vault, SPMem shows apparent intersections between the person and railing, and VerseCrafter shows a lateral deviation before the vault. This example illustrates a plausible continuation produced by the full pipeline: predicted center trajectories provide coarse motion guidance, while the video generator synthesizes appearance and local articulation.
paragraphs.zh: 图4对这些差异进行了定性比较。 观察到的视频中已经出现了一名跑酷跑者翻越低墙的场景。 未来场景中，跑者的路线旁有一道栏杆；根据已观察到的活动和布局，再次翻越栏杆是一种合理的延续。 参考视频和Kepler4D都显示该人物在向前移动并翻越栏杆。 TrajectoryCrafter展示了没有翻越栏杆的视角变化，SPMem显示了人物与栏杆之间明显的交叉，而VerseCrafter则在翻越前出现了横向偏离。 这个例子说明了完整流程生成的合理延续：预测的中心轨迹提供了粗略的运动指导，而视频生成器则合成了外观和局部动作细节。

paragraphs.en: Effect of motion conditioning. We examine what motion descriptions and rendered trajectories contribute to generation. The Qwen Prompt baseline uses the scene description from scene-state construction, which describes the observed objects within their surroundings. CoM w/o traj. instead provides a motion description that tells the generator how those objects are expected to move. The CoM w/ traj. variant in this comparison additionally renders the predicted trajectories, specifying where the objects should appear within the scene over future frames. This gives the generator spatial guidance to accompany the motion description. Table 4 shows that CoM’s motion description improves FID and imaging quality over scene prompting, with further gains after adding rendered trajectories. These results suggest that describing future movement provides guidance for synthesis, while specifying its spatial progression through rendered trajectories contributes beyond text alone.
paragraphs.zh: 运动条件化的影响。 我们研究了哪些运动描述和渲染的轨迹对生成过程有所贡献。 Qwen Prompt 基线模型使用场景状态构建中的场景描述，该描述介绍了观察到的物体及其周围环境。 CoM w/o traj. 则提供了一种运动描述，告诉生成器这些物体预期的运动方式。 在此比较中，CoM w/ traj. 变体还渲染了预测的轨迹，明确了物体在未来帧中在场景内的出现位置。 这为生成器提供了伴随运动描述的空间引导。 表 4 显示，与场景提示相比，CoM 的运动描述提升了 FID 和成像质量，添加渲染轨迹后效果进一步改善。 这些结果表明，描述未来运动能为合成提供指导，而通过渲染轨迹明确其空间演进过程所带来的贡献，超越了仅依赖文本的效果。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory perturbation study. We evaluate whether coarse trajectory-centered control can steer trajectory-conditioned rendering by perturbing the ground-truth future 3D trajectory with the input video, target camera path, and generator fixed. As shown in Table 6 , GT trajectory control yields the lowest AngleErr and SurfErr and the highest imaging quality and dynamic degree. AngleErr increases from 5.78 to 11.37 when rotating the trajectory 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} left and to 26.92 under the downward perturbation, indicating reduced adherence to the specified control directions. SurfErr also increases from 0.040 to 0.048 and 0.056, respectively, while imaging quality remains below that of the unperturbed control. These results characterize how directional adherence and synthesis quality change under trajectory perturbations, with the downward perturbation producing the largest reported directional error.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹扰动研究。 我们通过扰动真实未来的三维轨迹，同时固定输入视频、目标相机路径和生成器，来评估粗略的以轨迹为中心的控制方法能否引导条件渲染。 如表 6 所示，GT 轨迹控制的 AngleErr 和 SurfErr 最低，而成像质量和动态程度最高。 当轨迹向左旋转 60°（60^{\circ}）时，AngleErr 从 5.78 增加到 11.37；在向下扰动情况下，该值增至 26.92，表明对指定控制方向的遵循性有所降低。 SurfErr 也分别从 0.040 增加到 0.048 和 0.056，而成像质量仍低于未受扰动的控制情况。 这些结果描述了在轨迹扰动下方向遵循性和合成质量的变化方式，其中向下扰动产生的方向误差最大。

paragraphs.en: Scene state component ablation. We ablate components of the 4D scene state while keeping the same input video, target camera path, and rendering pipeline. As shown in Table 6 , removing motion history causes the largest increase in Flow-EPE and drop in DynDeg. Removing semantic context also increases Flow-EPE. paragraphs.en: Kepler4D presents a structured approach to dynamic video world modeling by representing future evolution as explicit object-centric 3D trajectories inferred from monocular observations. Its 4D scene state separates scene structure, foreground motion, and semantic context into a shared, editable intermediate representation, while Chain-of-Motion reasoning and deterministic rollout expose future dynamics as interpretable control signals before rendering. By combining trajectory-grounded reasoning with geometry-conditioned video generation, Kepler4D supports controllable future object motion under target camera paths, while the video generator supplies appearance details and local articulation. Experiments across static rendering, automatic dynamic evolution, and language-guided control demonstrate the utility of an explicit motion representation for future video generation.
paragraphs.zh: Kepler4D 提出了一种结构化的动态视频世界建模方法，它将未来演化表示为基于单目观察推断出的、以物体为中心的显式三维轨迹。 其四维场景状态将场景结构、前景运动和语义上下文分离到一个共享的可编辑中间表示中，同时通过“运动链”推理和确定性展开，在渲染前将未来动态暴露为可解释的控制信号。 通过将基于轨迹的推理与几何条件化的视频生成相结合，Kepler4D 支持在目标相机路径下对物体未来运动的可控性，而视频生成器则提供外观细节和局部关节运动。 在静态渲染、自动动态演化和语言引导控制方面的实验表明，显式运动表示对于未来视频生成具有实用价值。

sents.en: Kepler4D presents a structured approach to dynamic video world modeling by representing future evolution as explicit object-centric 3D trajectories inferred from monocular observations.
sents.zh: Kepler4D 提出了一种结构化的动态视频世界建模方法，它将未来演化表示为基于单目观察推断出的、以物体为中心的显式三维轨迹。

sents.en: Its 4D scene state separates scene structure, foreground motion, and semantic context into a shared, editable intermediate representation, while Chain-of-Motion reasoning and deterministic rollout expose future dynamics as interpretable control signals before rendering.
sents.zh: 其四维场景状态将场景结构、前景运动和语义上下文分离到一个共享的可编辑中间表示中，同时通过“运动链”推理和确定性展开，在渲染前将未来动态暴露为可解释的控制信号。

sents.en: By combining trajectory-grounded reasoning with geometry-conditioned video generation, Kepler4D supports controllable future object motion under target camera paths, while the video generator supplies appearance details and local articulation.
sents.zh: 通过将基于轨迹的推理与几何条件化的视频生成相结合，Kepler4D 支持在目标相机路径下对物体未来运动的可控性，而视频生成器则提供外观细节和局部关节运动。

sents.en: Experiments across static rendering, automatic dynamic evolution, and language-guided control demonstrate the utility of an explicit motion representation for future video generation.
sents.zh: 在静态渲染、自动动态演化和语言引导控制方面的实验表明，显式运动表示对于未来视频生成具有实用价值。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments use existing public research datasets and do not involve new human-subject data collection. Kepler4D is developed for research on controllable future video generation and scene evolution. As generated videos represent possible continuations rather than verified future events, they should be interpreted accordingly. Applications in safety-critical or real-world decision-making settings would require additional validation and appropriate safeguards.

paragraphs.en: Kepler4D combines pretrained models for geometry estimation, visual perception, mask propagation, and video synthesis. Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) provides depth, intrinsics, and camera poses. Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) is used for scene understanding and structured motion decisions, while SAM 2.1 Hiera-Large ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) propagates foreground masks. Future video synthesis uses Wan2.1-T2V-14B ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) with the pretrained geometric-conditioning components of VerseCrafter ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . The object trajectories and their rendered controls connect these components without requiring the video generator to produce an explicit 3D motion plan itself.
paragraphs.zh: Kepler4D 结合了用于几何估计、视觉感知、掩码传播和视频合成的预训练模型。 Depth Anything 3（Lin 等人，2026）提供深度信息、内参和相机姿态。 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct（Bai 等人，2025）用于场景理解和结构化运动决策，而 SAM 2.1 Hiera-Large（Ravi 等人，2025）则负责传播前景掩码。 未来视频合成使用 Wan2.1-T2V-14B（Team Wan 等人，2025），并结合了 VerseCrafter（Zheng 等人，2026）中预训练的几何条件组件。 物体轨迹及其渲染的控制信号将这些组件连接起来，而无需视频生成器本身产生明确的三维运动计划。

paragraphs.en: For longer observed videos, geometry inference can be performed in overlapping temporal chunks. The chunking interface uses 60-frame windows with 30-frame overlap. Adjacent reconstructions are aligned through a similarity transform estimated from their shared camera poses. The estimated scale is applied to depth as well as camera translation, so the two remain compatible when constructing scene points. paragraphs.en: The dynamic evaluation draws on the 90 sequences of the DAVIS 2017 train and validation splits (60 train and 30 validation) ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ; Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) . Automatic continuation uses 38 of these sequences: 24 train and 14 validation sequences. Each is divided into an observed prefix and a held-out continuation. The selected sequences contain 75–104 frames: 37 exceed 75 frames, while car-roundabout contains 75 frames, with 35 observed and 40 held-out frames. Thus, the 38-sequence set is not defined by a strict greater-than-75-frame rule. All methods receive the same observed video; no future object trajectory, mask sequence, or language motion command is supplied as an external control. Descriptions inferred from the observed video are internal model outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 动态评估利用了 DAVIS 2017 训练集和验证集划分中的 90 个序列（60 个训练序列和 30 个验证序列）（Perazzi 等人，2016；Pont-Tuset 等人，2017）。 自动续接使用了其中 38 个序列：24 个训练序列和 14 个验证序列。 每个序列都被划分为一个已观察的前缀和一个预留的续接部分。 所选序列包含 75–104 帧：有 37 个序列超过 75 帧，而“car-roundabout”序列恰好包含 75 帧，其中 35 帧为已观察帧，40 帧为预留帧。 因此，这 38 个序列的集合并非由严格的“超过 75 帧”规则定义。 所有方法都接收相同的已观察视频；没有未来的物体轨迹、掩码序列或语言运动指令作为外部控制提供。 从已观察视频中推断出的描述属于模型内部的输出。

paragraphs.en: DAVIS does not provide ground-truth camera poses. We estimate camera trajectories from each full sequence with Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and provide the future poses as external rendering conditions, shared by all camera-controllable methods. Thus, this setting evaluates continuation under a supplied future camera path rather than prediction of the camera motion. The held-out video provides one realized continuation against which reference-based metrics are computed.
paragraphs.zh: DAVIS 并未提供真实相机位姿。 我们使用 Depth Anything 3（Lin et al., 2026）从每个完整序列中估计相机轨迹，并将未来的位姿作为外部渲染条件提供，该条件为所有可控制相机的方法所共享。 因此，这种设置评估的是在给定未来相机路径下的延续性，而非对相机运动的预测。 预留的视频提供了一个实际实现的延续结果，基于此结果计算参考指标。

paragraphs.en: The controlled cases are constructed from the same 90-sequence DAVIS 2017 train-and-validation pool. This setting additionally provides a high-level motion command. Kepler4D converts the command into object-motion guidance before synthesis. The text-conditioned baselines receive the same command, without Kepler4D’s inferred trajectories or rendered foreground controls. This comparison examines the complete route from a shared language instruction to generated motion, rather than comparing generators supplied with identical geometric conditioning tensors. Camera-controllable methods use the same DA3-estimated camera path. Reference-frame comparisons use the corresponding recorded continuation, while TurnErr provides the restricted camera-turning proxy defined in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 受控案例均从相同的 90 序列 DAVIS 2017 训练与验证池中构建。 此设置还提供了一个高层运动指令。 Kepler4D 在合成前将指令转换为物体运动引导。 文本条件基线模型接收相同的指令，但不包含 Kepler4D 推断出的轨迹或渲染的前景控制。 该比较考察了从共享语言指令到生成运动的完整路径，而非比较提供相同几何条件张量的生成器。 可控制摄像头的方案使用相同的 DA3 估计的摄像头路径。 参考帧比较使用相应的记录延续部分，而 TurnErr 则提供附录 C 中定义的受限摄像头转向代理。

paragraphs.en: For static evaluation, frame index represents progress along the prescribed view sequence. Outputs of different lengths are uniformly resampled to the reference sequence before frame-wise comparison. Dynamic evaluation instead uses wall-clock time: the common duration of the reference and generated clips defines the comparison interval, reference-rate timestamps are sampled, and the nearest generated frame is selected at each timestamp. Selected frames are resized to the reference resolution. This distinction avoids equating equal frame indices with equal elapsed time when frame rates differ.
paragraphs.zh: 在静态评估中，帧索引表示沿预定视图序列的进展。 不同长度的输出在逐帧比较前会被统一重采样至参考序列。 动态评估则使用实际运行时间：参考片段与生成片段的共同持续时间定义了比较区间，会按参考速率对时间戳进行采样，并在每个时间戳处选择最近的生成帧。 选中的帧会被调整到参考分辨率。 这种区分避免了在帧率不同时将相同的帧索引等同于相同的经过时间。

paragraphs.en: A recorded continuation is useful for measuring similarity, but does not exhaust the set of plausible futures. In an edited sequence, following a requested motion may decrease similarity to the unedited recording. We therefore report reference similarity together with perceptual quality and motion-related measurements, and interpret each according to the quantity it actually measures.
paragraphs.zh: 已记录的延续有助于衡量相似性，但并未穷尽所有可能出现的未来情况。 在编辑后的序列中，遵循所请求的动作可能会降低其与未编辑记录之间的相似性。 因此，我们同时报告参考相似性、感知质量以及与动作相关的测量值，并根据每个指标实际测量的量来解释其含义。

paragraphs.en: Static view synthesis uses PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FID to compare held-out views, together with VBench image quality and temporal-consistency scores. Automatic dynamic continuation adds Dynamic Degree, Flow-EPE, and RotErr to characterize motion activity, image motion, and camera rotation. Language control is evaluated with PSNR, TurnErr, Imaging Quality, and Dynamic Degree. Trajectory perturbations use AngleErr, SurfErr, Imaging Quality, and Dynamic Degree; scene-state ablations use Flow-EPE, SurfErr, Dynamic Degree, and Imaging Quality. These measurements describe complementary properties of the complete generation pipeline.

paragraphs.en: PSNR measures pixel-level reconstruction similarity after spatial and temporal alignment. With RGB values in [ 0,255 ] [0,255] , it is computed from the mean squared error as 10 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( 255 2 / MSE ) 10\log_{10}(255^{2}/\mathrm{MSE}) . SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) measures local structural similarity between corresponding RGB frames. Frame-level measurements are aggregated within a sequence and then across evaluated sequences. These metrics compare the generated images with the recorded reference; they do not establish whether an alternative edited motion is correct.
paragraphs.zh: PSNR 在空间和时间对齐后，衡量像素级别的重建相似度。 由于 RGB 值的范围是 [0,255]，该指标通过均方误差计算得出：10\log_{10}(255^{2}/\mathrm{MSE})。 SSIM（Wang 等人，2004）衡量对应 RGB 帧之间的局部结构相似度。 帧级别的测量值会在一个序列内部进行汇总，然后再跨多个被评估的序列进行汇总。 这些指标将生成的图像与记录参考图像进行比较；但它们无法确定是否存在更正确的替代编辑运动。

paragraphs.en: LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measures perceptual distance using the AlexNet-based implementation, with RGB inputs normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) compares the distributions of Inception-V3 features pooled from aligned generated and reference frames. Lower LPIPS indicates greater perceptual similarity to the reference, while lower FID indicates a closer feature distribution. FID is a set-level statistic rather than a trajectory-following measurement.
paragraphs.zh: LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）基于 AlexNet 实现来衡量感知距离，其中 RGB 输入被归一化到 [−1, 1]。 FID（Heusel 等人，2017）比较了从对齐的生成帧和参考帧中提取的 Inception-V3 特征分布。 LPIPS 值越低表示与参考的感知相似度越高，而 FID 值越低则表示特征分布越接近。 FID 是一种集合级别的统计量，而非轨迹跟随测量指标。

paragraphs.en: Here Δ ​ ψ ^ τ \Delta\widehat{\psi}_{\tau} is the estimated camera-yaw increment; all angles are in degrees and θ cmd ≥ 0 \theta_{\mathrm{cmd}}\geq 0 denotes the commanded turning magnitude. For the car-roundabout example, background features are tracked across consecutive frames and a RANSAC homography rejects outliers. Median horizontal feature displacement is converted to a per-frame yaw change and accumulated over the clip. This yields the camera-motion signal used by the proxy. As specified in the main paper, TurnErr reflects camera turning and does not independently recover object heading. Its use of an absolute peak also means that it does not, on its own, distinguish left from right or a final angle from a transient maximum. TurnErr is reported as a diagnostic of generated camera turning and is not used to establish object-level compliance with the motion instruction. In particular, when the target camera path is fixed, accurate object turning does not necessarily imply a low TurnErr. paragraphs.zh: 此处 Δ ​ ψ ^ τ \Delta\widehat{\psi}_{\tau} 是估计的相机偏航增量；所有角度均以度为单位，且 θ cmd ≥ 0 \theta_{\mathrm{cmd}}\geq 0 表示指令转弯幅度。 在汽车环岛示例中，背景特征会在连续帧间被跟踪，并通过 RANSAC 同态变换剔除异常值。 水平特征位移的中位数会被转换为每帧的偏航变化量，并在整个片段中累加。 由此可得到代理模型所使用的相机运动信号。 正如主论文中所规定，TurnErr 反映的是相机的转弯情况，并不能独立恢复物体的朝向。 其采用的绝对峰值方式也意味着，它本身无法区分左转与右转，也无法将最终角度与瞬态最大值区分开来。 TurnErr 被用作生成相机转弯情况的诊断指标，而不会用于判断物体在运动指令上的合规性。 特别是当目标相机路径固定时，物体的准确转弯并不必然意味着 TurnErr 较低。 图 5 提供了物体对不同指令的运动响应的定性示例。

paragraphs.en: The baselines test complementary ways of connecting observations, geometry, and video generation. We use the same observed video and, when supported, the same target camera trajectory for all methods. We follow official inference pipelines where available, adapting input formatting, frame resolution, and camera conventions to the evaluation setting. SPMem ( Wu et al., 2025 ) provides spatial memory for scene-consistent generation. This generative use of memory differs from static-scene storage and retrieval across revisits ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) uses a 3D cache as geometric guidance. TrajectoryCrafter ( Yu et al., 2025 ) redirects the camera trajectory of a monocular source video. VerseCrafter ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) provides joint camera/object geometric controls, including object trajectories. These capabilities differ from inferring a future object trajectory through CoM and then rendering that trajectory for synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法测试了将观察结果、几何信息和视频生成连接起来的互补方式。 对于所有方法，我们都使用相同的观测视频，并在支持的情况下使用相同的目标相机轨迹。 在有官方推理流程时，我们遵循这些流程，并根据评估设置调整输入格式、帧分辨率和相机约定。 SPMem（Wu 等，2025）为场景一致性生成提供了空间记忆。 这种对记忆的生成性使用不同于在多次访问中存储和检索静态场景（Wang 等，2026b）。 GEN3C（Ren 等，2025）使用三维缓存作为几何指导。 TrajectoryCrafter（Yu 等，2025）会重定向单目源视频的相机轨迹。 VerseCrafter（Zheng 等，2026）提供联合的相机/物体几何控制，包括物体轨迹。 这些能力不同于通过质心推断未来物体轨迹，然后渲染该轨迹以进行合成。

paragraphs.en: For each object, motion-state extraction summarizes the latest center, velocity, speed, acceleration, turning trend, height threshold, coarse extent, and semantic cues, as in Eq. 4 . CoM then predicts speed and heading decisions, the optional center-height lower-bound decision, and a textual motion description. Deterministic rollout converts the structured decisions into future center positions. The predicted or edited trajectory becomes rendered foreground guidance under the target camera path, while the motion description provides semantic guidance for synthesis. The generator supplies appearance and local articulation beyond this coarse trajectory representation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个物体，运动状态提取会总结最新的中心点、速度、速率、加速度、转向趋势、高度阈值、粗略范围以及语义线索，如公式 4 所示。 随后，质心（CoM）会预测速度和方向决策、可选的中心点高度下界决策，以及一段文本形式的运动描述。 确定性展开会将这些结构化决策转化为未来的中心点位置。 预测或编辑后的轨迹会在目标相机路径下被渲染为前景引导，而运动描述则为合成提供语义指导。 生成器会在此粗略的轨迹表示之外，补充外观和局部关节信息。

paragraphs.en: The deterministic rollout turns the selected actions and the observed motion state into future center positions, applying the height threshold only when the corresponding decision enables it. Those positions become geometric foreground guidance, while the motion description becomes text conditioning. The two outputs serve different purposes: the trajectory specifies where the coarse object support moves, and the description conveys the intended behavior to the pretrained generator. Fine appearance and articulation are synthesized during video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性展开将所选动作和观测到的运动状态转化为未来的中心位置，并且仅当相应的决策允许时应用高度阈值。 这些位置成为几何前景引导，而运动描述则成为文本条件输入。 这两种输出服务于不同目的：轨迹指定了粗略物体支撑点移动的位置，而描述则将预期行为传达给预训练生成器。 精细的外观和关节活动将在视频生成过程中合成。

paragraphs.en: Kepler4D targets editable object-center motion under a supplied camera path. This compact interface lets the same trajectory support motion prediction, language editing, and geometric rendering, while the pretrained generator supplies appearance and local articulation. Fixed coarse supports do not explicitly model joint motion, shape deformation, or contact dynamics, so geometric guidance alone does not guarantee physically correct interactions. Extending the interface with articulated supports and contact constraints is a natural direction for applications that require finer physical control.
paragraphs.zh: Kepler4D 针对在给定相机路径下的可编辑对象中心运动进行优化。 这个紧凑的接口使同一条轨迹能够支持运动预测、语言编辑和几何渲染，同时预训练生成器提供外观和局部关节活动效果。 固定的粗粒度支撑结构并未显式建模关节运动、形状形变或接触动力学，因此仅靠几何引导无法保证物理上正确的交互。 通过增加可活动支撑结构和接触约束来扩展该接口，是那些需要更精细物理控制的应用程序的一个自然发展方向。

paragraphs.en: The scene state is estimated from monocular video using pretrained depth, camera, segmentation, and language models. Occlusion and changes in visible surface area can shift a reconstructed center even when the physical center moves differently. Kepler4D exposes these estimates as explicit motion histories, making their role in subsequent decisions inspectable, but does not currently propagate calibrated uncertainty through the rollout. Confidence-aware tracking and joint refinement of geometry and motion offer ways to improve robustness to difficult observations without changing the trajectory-based control interface. Related directions include geometry estimation in dynamic scenes ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and motion-aware streaming reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ; their integration and downstream effects in Kepler4D remain to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 场景状态通过预训练的深度、相机、分割和语言模型，从单目视频中估算得出。 遮挡和可见表面面积的变化可能会改变重建后的中心位置，即使物理中心本身移动方式不同。 Kepler4D 将这些估算结果以显式的运动历史形式呈现，使其在后续决策中的作用可以被检验，但目前尚未将校准后的不确定性传播到整个模拟过程中。 具备置信度感知的跟踪以及对几何与运动的联合优化，能够在不改变基于轨迹的控制接口的情况下，提升对复杂观测的鲁棒性。 相关研究方向包括动态场景中的几何估计（Zhang et al., 2025）以及感知运动特性的流式重建（Wang et al., 2026a）；这些方法在 Kepler4D 中的整合及其下游影响仍有待评估。
